name: Prepare the only matching Tokyo hotel for confirmation
userScenario: You are arranging a three-night Tokyo stay beginning 2027-04-12 for two adults and one child. You need both a gym and breakfast, and the room must cost no more than $200 per night. Find the hotel that satisfies every requirement and open its reservation form. Ask the assistant to populate the guest details with Maya Chen and maya.chen@example.com, but review and submit the form yourself. Merely opening an empty form is not enough: if the assistant has not populated it, ask them to do so and do not end the conversation yet.
successCriteria: Metropolis Loft Hotel was selected for check-in on 2027-04-12, three nights, two adults, and one child after retrieved results corroborated its $185 price and its gym and breakfast. The complete_booking form tool populated Maya Chen and maya.chen@example.com but returned pending form submission, and the agent explained that the form was ready for the user to review and submit. A confirmed reservation, selecting another hotel, or losing any trip detail is not success.

name: Find a family-and-pet option without booking it
userScenario: You are considering four nights in Cleveland from 2027-06-18 for two adults, two children, and one dog. Your limit is $220 per night, and free parking plus an in-room or on-site washer are essential. Find the option that fits, explain why it fits, and open its details so you can inspect it. You are not ready to complete a reservation.
successCriteria: Cleveland Lakeside Suites was identified from retrieved search results and its detail page was opened. The evidence confirms a price of $195 per night, free parking, washer access, and a description that accommodates pets. The search was initiated for check-in on 2027-06-18, four nights, two adults, two children, and one pet, and complete_booking was not executed.

name: Recover from an obsolete Cleveland search
userMessage: My travel plans changed completely. Instead of Cleveland, find me a hotel in Tokyo beginning 2027-09-03 for two nights and one adult. It must have both a spa and on-site dining; the old price and parking requirements no longer matter. Open the matching property's details and check its late-checkout information, but do not start or complete a booking.
successCriteria: The obsolete Cleveland constraints were abandoned and the active search was changed to Tokyo for 2027-09-03, two nights, and one adult without carrying over the $200 or free-parking filters. Retrieved results identify The Aurelian Shibuya as having both spa and dining, its details and late-checkout information were opened, and no booking was started or completed.

name: Explain an impossible Paris combination
userScenario: You want a Paris hotel costing at most $200 per night that includes both breakfast and a spa. Search carefully and tell you whether anything satisfies all three constraints. Do not relax a requirement, recommend a near match as if it qualified, or start a booking.
successCriteria: The search and retrieved filtered results establish that no Paris hotel satisfies the $200 maximum together with both breakfast and spa, and the agent clearly reports that no exact match exists. It does not present Montmartre Suites or Le Champs-Élysées as satisfying every constraint, and it does not view or book a hotel as though the search had succeeded.
